name: Dwarven Outfitters
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
What do we have here? You look as though you might need something to keep your hands warm, hm?

I'll tell you what would help: a pair of nice, warm gloves. And, being the kind soul that I am, I'd be more than happy to provide you with a suitable pair. I've one condition, however.

I need you to go get me some wolf meat. Nice arrangement, hm? You bring me some wolf meat, and I'll make sure you don't lose any digits to frostbite. Well, what do you say?
narrative.objectives: Sten Stoutarm would like 8 pieces of Tough Wolf Meat.
narrative.offerRewardText: Ah! Wonderful. The wolf meat should do nicely. Oh, don't worry, adventurer, I wouldn't forget my part of the bargain. Here, one of these should fit you.
narrative.requestItemsText: Wolves giving you a bit of trouble? You'd do well to avoid the fangs and claws and other sharp bits, yes?
